why: The drafts carry an adoption-cost scan deliberately coupled to the repository tree: it measures every committed artifact that would have to be re-recorded or explained if a declaration were adopted. The tool's own documentation states the coupling and the response: re-render. The alternative — leaving the enumeration out of date — would tell the operator a smaller adoption cost than the tree now carries.
